title: Ziggurat New project draft
description: Everything the console's New project page holds. POST it to /api/drafts; the console checks it with the same rules as the form, keeps it as a draft and answers with {id, url, warnings}. Open the url (/new?draft=<id>) to read, change and send it. A draft never deploys anything.

name.description: The project's name, shown on its card.

id.description: Also the VM's name and the repository folder. Left out: made from the name.

description.description: One line on the project card.

remote.description: Optional ssh address of an empty repository to publish main to: git@host:owner/repo.git.

kind.description: A team template (templates/<id>) or a prepared team folder in the projects folder.

goal.description: What the team should build, for whom, and how to tell it is good. Goes into the charter's {{goal}} slot as written. Needed for a template.

docs.description: The owner's plan and design documents, put into the new repository's docs/ folder. At most 2 MB together.

plan.description: When it's ready: one planning cycle after the gate proof passes. The lead writes no code; proposals appear on the Backlog tab; the team stays halted.

charter.description: Advanced: the whole charter, replacing the team's. Keep {{goal}} in it to have the goal filled in.

target.description: Advanced: the deploy target id. Left out: the first target.
